oneLine: Rediff.com's IPO plans may get a fresh UPI tailwind.

sources.title: Rediff.com's IPO plans may get a fresh UPI tailwind as new MDR regime kicks in

synopsis: Rediff.com is preparing for an initial public offering with a reported issue size of approximately Rs 600-800 crore after receiving SEBI approval in August. The upcoming IPO may benefit from the government's new Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) regime of 0.4% on select high-value UPI merchant transactions effective October 15, which could provide additional monetisation avenues as the company scales its consumer UPI app, RediffPay. AvenuesAI Limited owns 82.66% of Rediff.com.
